evidence_items.publisher: Alex Kantrowitz, Big Technology, published on LinkedIn
evidence_items.locator: Tl;dr section; underlying interviews in Model Commoditization and Margin Compression
evidence_items.explanation: Customer interviews identify credible competitive vulnerabilities, while the article also describes OpenAI's lead and frames much of the danger as future pressure. This supports vulnerability but does not establish an existing commercial crisis.
Reported platform adoption qualifies a claim of immediate commercial distress. These are company-announced usage figures, not independent proof of profitability or durable customer retention.

unresolved_gaps: The reviewed records do not establish material customer losses or other realized commercial damage before the firing.
Competitive vulnerability does not supply a measurable threshold for crisis.
Usage figures do not establish whether the business was financially secure.
